company.shortDescription: Solar streetlights: self-sufficient lighting solutions that are powered by solar panels and do not require any external power source.
company.description:
Solar streetlights are self-sufficient lighting solutions that are powered by solar panels and do not require any external power source. These products use renewable energy from the sun to charge their batteries during the day and use that energy to illuminate streets, pathways, and other outdoor areas at night.

Solar streetlights have become increasingly popular due to their energy efficiency, low maintenance costs, and environmental benefits. They can be installed in remote or off-grid locations where traditional electricity sources are not available or too expensive to access.
